title: Scheduled Tasks
subtitle: Schedule work, follow its progress, and keep the results separate from the schedule.
copyHint: This is a new, paused task. Review dates and settings before enabling it. Run history and ownership are not copied.
copyNotAllowed: You need permission to view this task's prompt before copying it.
empty: Create a scheduled task, or view ended tasks in All.
noMatchesHint: Try another search or remove some filters.
name: Name
promptDesc: Sent to the narrator for every run. Describe the expected result and how to verify it.
promptRestricted: Only the owner or an administrator can view instructions and the system prompt.
readOnly: You have read-only access to this task.
specificTimes: Run once at each selected date and time
monthDaysHint: Dates that do not exist in a month are skipped.
cronExprDesc: Use advanced cron for rules such as the first Monday of each month. The server validates the expression.
timezoneDesc: Dates and times are interpreted in this timezone, not converted from your browser's timezone.
countHint: Missed and failed scheduled occurrences count too. Manual runs do not consume planned occurrences.
previewHint: Calculated by the server using the same engine as execution. Missed occurrences are recorded, not replayed.
previewExhausted: No future occurrences. Check the dates and end condition.
previewFinite: This schedule has an end condition.
scheduleResetWarning: Changing the schedule or timezone starts a new sequence and resets the planned-occurrence count. Existing run history is preserved.
schedulePreserved: Saving other settings preserves the schedule, anchor and planned-occurrence count.
lifecycleHint: Ended means the schedule is exhausted, not that the work succeeded. Check each run's system status and model report.
circuitBreakerHint: Repeated failures paused this task automatically. Review the last run before resuming.
runStarted: Run requested. Follow its progress in the run history.
notFound: This task is unavailable, deleted, or not visible to you.
creator: Creator
unowned: No owner · administrator can take over
ownerHint: The owner is the identity used for execution and receives task notifications. Transferring ownership does not change creation history.
transferHint: The new owner becomes the execution identity. Existing schedule, history and permission limits are retained.
cwdDesc: Absolute path. Leave empty to use the home directory.
cwdProjectDesc: Absolute path. Leave empty to use the project directory.
projectDesc: Each run's narrator belongs to this project.
projectsLoadFailed: Could not load projects. Reload and try again.
noProjectsAvailable: No projects are available. Ask an owner or administrator for project access.
narratorModeDesc: Create a fresh narrator each run, or reuse the task's dedicated narrator.
targetSearch: Search narrators by title or ID
targetHint: Only sessions you can write to are listed. Directory, project, permissions, system prompt and plan mode follow the target session.
targetsLoadFailed: Could not load narrators. Try again.
targetUnavailable: The target is unavailable or you no longer have write access. Select another narrator.
existingInherited: Directory, project, permissions, system prompt and plan mode follow the target session. Its history is excluded from cleanup.
existingModelPolicyHint: Follow the target's current model by default, override it for this run, or synchronize the task model each run.
contextClearWarning: Each run clears the target session's context. Confirm that this session can start over.

busyPolicy.wait: Wait until the target is idle

busyWaitHint: The task is not dispatched while waiting. It is skipped when the wait expires.
busyInterruptWarning: The target's current work will be interrupted. This task starts after it stops.
requireReportHint: Ask the narrator to report its result. When off, task instructions are still sent and voluntary reports remain available. A normal end without a report is shown as ended, with no report required.
associationsLoadFailed: Could not load associated scheduled tasks.
modelDesc: Choose the task's model, or use the default.
modelPolicyHint: Permissions and the system prompt are synchronized before every run regardless of model policy.

policy.temporary: Override for this run, then restore

managedGeneric: This session is managed by a scheduled task.
managedConfig: Each run applies the task's model policy, permissions and system prompt.
managedModelReset: The next scheduled run will restore the task's configured model.
permissionModeDesc: The permission ceiling for unattended execution.
bypassWarning: Bypass permits arbitrary commands and file changes without approval. Use only with trusted instructions.
onBlockedHint: Without waiting: questions receive guidance, plans are approved, permission requests are denied. With waiting: notify the owner and stop waiting at the limit.

blockedPolicy.auto: Do not wait for a person

notificationHint: Failures, blocked runs, timeouts and automatic pauses always notify the owner.
cleanupKeepLatestN: Keep the latest N created sessions
cleanupOlderThanDays: Delete sessions inactive for N days
cleanupWarning: Permanently deletes sessions created by this task and their descendants. Running sessions, terminals and oversized histories are protected. Legacy sessions without creation provenance are not removed. Each cleanup deletes at most 10 roots; repeat for a backlog.
cleanupConfirm: Apply the saved retention policy to “{{name}}” now? Run history is preserved.
cleanupResult: Deleted {{deletedRoots}} root sessions ({{deletedNarrators}} with descendants); protected {{blockedRoots}}. More may remain: {{limited}}.
noRuns: No runs yet. History will appear here when the task runs.
focusedRunNotLoaded: The linked run is not in the loaded records. Clear the result filter or load more history.

validation.too_many_times: Too many times in one schedule.
validation.invalid_datetime: Choose a valid date and time.
validation.invalid_month_days: Choose at least one day of the month.
validation.end_before_start: The end must not be before the start.

unsavedBody: Leaving this page will discard your unsaved changes.
